svg.title: What a pitch deck costs in November 2026
svg.desc: Bar chart of published pitch deck design prices in November 2026. Design of your own content: Slidebean $799, Cosmos Studio from $1,000, Pitch Deck Creators $1,500, Pitchfast $2,499. With story writing: Pitchfast $3,499, Pitch Deck Creators from $5,000, Waveup from $6,000, Slidebean strategy sprint from $6,000.
svg.text: What a pitch deck costs in November 2026
List prices from each vendor’s own page, checked November 23, 2026.
Per-slide services (24Slides $16–66 a slide, Waveup from $100 a slide) and freelancers ($500–3,000, Waveup’s
estimate) are in the table above.
